title: Playboy Magazine February 1970 William Burroughs Alan Watts Drug Scene
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. These 1970 issues show age and storage wear including cover wear, creasing, edge/corner wear and discoloration. Please review the photo for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, February 1970 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
